paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption: The character distribution in RoleplayPref consists of 3 primary categories and 13 subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е кръгова диаграма, която представя разпределението на категориите герои в RoleplayPref. Има 3 основни категории и 13 подкатегории. Основните категории са "Виртуални герои", "Реални герои" и "Персонализирани герои", представени съответно в синьо, зелено и червено. "Виртуалните герои" заемат най-голям дял от диаграмата, а под тях са категоризирани "Герои от комикси", "Герои от филми", "Герои от теленовели", "Герои от романи" и "Герои от игри". "Реалните герои" са разделени на осем подкатегории: "Учени", "Артисти", "Атлети", "Писатели", "Музиканти", "Актьори" и "Инфлуенсъри". Диаграмата включва етикети за всяка категория и подкатегория, но няма легенда или проценти, посочени в секторите. Подкатегориите са подредени около основните категории по начин, който изглежда последователен, като "Виртуалните герои" имат по-големи подкатегории в сравнение с другите две основни категории. Секторите не са визуално подчертани, а цветовете се използват за разграничаване на основните категории и техните подкатегории.
model_annotations.English: The chart represents the distribution of characters in RoleplayPref across various categories. The pie chart is divided into 13 slices, grouped into three primary categories: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters. Virtual Characters, colored in different shades of blue and comprising approximately 68% of the chart, is further divided into five subcategories: Comic Characters (around 29%), Movie Characters (~11%), Teleplay Characters (~8%), Novel Characters (~9%), and Game Characters (~11%). Custom Characters, colored pink and making up around 17%, is a single subcategory. Real Characters, colored green and accounting for about 15%, is further divided into seven subcategories: Scientists (~3%), Artists (~2%), Athletes (~2%), Writers (~2%), Musicians (~2%), Actors (~2%), and Influencers (~2%). The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are placed inside or adjacent to their respective slices, and the slices are visually distinguishable by color. The segments appear to be ordered by category, with subcategories arranged around their respective primary categories.
model_annotations.German: This diagram is a circular chart illustrating the distribution of character categories. The chart is divided into 13 segments, grouped into three primary categories: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters. The largest category, Virtual Characters, is depicted in shades of blue and comprises six subcategories: Comic Characters (approximately 30%), Game Characters (around 20%), Novel Characters (about 13%), Teleplay Characters (roughly 10%), Movie Characters (around 8%), and an unlabeled segment. Custom Characters are shown in red and make up about 16% of the chart. Real Characters, represented in various shades of green, account for approximately 21% and are further divided into seven subcategories: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Actors and Influencers being the largest subcategories within Real Characters. The chart does not include a legend, but the categories are labeled directly on the chart. The segments are arranged in a radial pattern, with the primary categories at the center and the subcategories extending outward.
